enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag and finalizing morning routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out work bag. Open bag. Pick up laptop. Put laptop in bag. Pick up charger. Put charger in bag. Pick up notebook and pen. Put in bag. Zip bag. Put on shoes. Put on coat. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Clock in.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Receive patient assignments. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Walk to nurses' station. Assist patient with mobility. Consult with doctor. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Complete paperwork. Clock out.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Pick up plate and glass. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher. Walk out.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.
